a1-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hello and Thanks
a1-01.scenario: Károly says hi to you at a café and offers you a tea.
a1-01.prompt: Say hi back, then accept the tea and thank him.
a1-01.canDo: I can greet someone and respond simply in Hungarian.

a1-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Who
a1-02.scenario: You meet Károly for the first time. Meg is with you.
a1-02.prompt: Say hi, say who you are (you are Anna), and tell him who she is.
a1-02.target: Szia! Én Anna vagyok. Ő Meg.
a1-02.canDo: I can say who I am.

a1-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is This?
a1-03.scenario: Károly puts something on the table that you don't recognize. Next to it is your book.
a1-03.prompt: Ask what it is. Then point to your book and say what it is.
a1-03.english: What is this? This is a book.
a1-03.canDo: I can ask what something is.

a1-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Me
a1-04.scenario: At the station a man asks you: Te Meg vagy? You are Anna.
a1-04.prompt: Say no, you're not Meg, say who you are, and ask if he is Károly.
a1-04.target: Nem, nem vagyok Meg. Anna vagyok. Te Károly vagy?
a1-04.english: No, I'm not Meg. I'm Anna. Are you Károly?
a1-04.canDo: I can ask and answer a yes/no question.

a1-05.title: Communicative Challenge: At Meg's
a1-05.scenario: You visit Meg. Károly is there too and hands you a cup.
a1-05.prompt: Greet Károly, ask what it is, and when he says it's a coffee, thank him.
a1-05.english: Hi, Károly! What is this? Thank you!
a1-05.canDo: I can use the core Unit 1 patterns in a short exchange.

a1-06.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Morning and Goodbye
a1-06.scenario: You meet Károly at the café in the morning. Later, when you leave, you say goodbye.
a1-06.prompt: Greet Károly with good morning, then say goodbye as you leave.
a1-06.canDo: I can greet someone and say goodbye at any time of day.

a1-07.title: Communicative Challenge: Please and Thank You
a1-07.scenario: Anna hands you a tea, but accidentally bumps your arm and apologizes.
a1-07.prompt: Thank Anna for the tea, and tell her that it's no problem.
cues: Say that it is no problem
a1-07.canDo: I can say please, thank you, and sorry in Hungarian.

a1-08.title: Communicative Challenge: How Are You?
a1-08.scenario: You run into Károly outside. He asks how you are doing.
a1-08.prompt: Tell Károly you are doing well, thank him, and ask how he is.
a1-08.canDo: I can ask someone how they are and say how I am.

a1-09.title: Communicative Challenge: Could You Repeat That?
a1-09.scenario: Mariann speaks very quickly and you do not catch what she said.
a1-09.prompt: Say you don't understand, and ask her to speak more slowly.
cues: Ask her to speak more slowly
a1-09.english: I don't understand. More slowly, please.
a1-09.canDo: I can ask someone to repeat or slow down when I do not understand.

a1-10.title: Communicative Challenge: Small Agreements
a1-10.scenario: András asks if you can wait five minutes before leaving.
a1-10.prompt: Agree to wait by saying okay.
a1-10.canDo: I can agree to requests using rendben and persze.

a1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Morning Encounter
a1-10-consolidation.scenario: You meet Anna in the morning. She asks how you are. Before leaving, you say goodbye.
a1-10-consolidation.prompt: Greet Anna with good morning, say you are well, thank her, and say goodbye.
cues: Say you are well and thank her
a1-10-consolidation.target: Jó reggelt! Jól vagyok, köszönöm. Viszlát!
a1-10-consolidation.english: Good morning! I'm well, thanks. Goodbye!
a1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can greet people and say goodbye in Hungarian.

a1-11.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Are You?
a1-11.scenario: You meet Anna at a gathering. She introduces herself and asks who you are.
a1-11.prompt: Tell Anna who you are (you are Meg) and ask who she is.
a1-11.target: Én Meg vagyok. Te ki vagy?
a1-11.english: I am Meg. Who are you?
a1-11.canDo: I can use én, te, and ő with vagyok and vagy to say who I am.

a1-12.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is That?
a1-12.scenario: Károly points to someone across the room.
a1-12.prompt: Ask Károly who she is, and when he says it's Anna, say she is a friend.
a1-12.english: Who is she? She is a friend.
a1-12.canDo: I can ask Ki ő? and Mi ez? to ask who or what something is.

a1-13.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Do You Live?
a1-13.scenario: You are chatting with Anna. She asks where you live in the city.
a1-13.prompt: Tell Anna you live here, and ask where she lives.
a1-13.target: Én itt lakom. És te, hol laksz?
a1-13.english: I live here. And you, where do you live?
a1-13.canDo: I can ask Hol laksz? and understand what it means.

a1-14.title: Communicative Challenge: Friends and People
a1-14.scenario: Anna asks you about the person standing next to Károly.
a1-14.prompt: Tell Anna he is a man and he is a friend.
a1-14.target: Ő egy férfi. Ő egy barát.
a1-14.english: He is a man. He is a friend.
a1-14.canDo: I can identify someone as a man, woman, or friend using simple noun phrases.

a1-15.title: Communicative Challenge: Introducing Myself
a1-15.scenario: You meet András for the first time with Károly.
a1-15.prompt: Say who you are (Meg), say you live here, and introduce Károly as a friend.
a1-15.target: Én Meg vagyok. Itt lakom. Károly egy barát.
a1-15.english: I am Meg. I live here. Károly is a friend.
a1-15.canDo: I can introduce myself and say who another person is.

a1-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: New in Budapest
a1-15-consolidation.scenario: You arrive at a meetup in Budapest and introduce yourself to the group.
a1-15-consolidation.prompt: Introduce yourself as Meg, say who your friend is (Károly), and say you live here.
a1-15-consolidation.target: Én Meg vagyok. Ő Károly. Itt lakom.
a1-15-consolidation.english: I am Meg. He is Károly. I live here.
a1-15-consolidation.canDo: I can introduce myself and identify another person.

a1-16a.title: Communicative Challenge: Counting to Ten
a1-16a.scenario: Károly is counting items on the table and stops at two.
a1-16a.prompt: Continue counting for him with three, four, and five.
a1-16a.canDo: I can count from zero to ten in Hungarian.

a1-16b.title: Communicative Challenge: Counting Teens
a1-16b.scenario: Károly counts eleven and twelve, then asks you to continue.
a1-16b.prompt: Say the next two numbers: thirteen and fourteen.
a1-16b.canDo: I can count from eleven to nineteen in Hungarian.

a1-17.title: Communicative Challenge: How Old Are You?
a1-17.scenario: Károly asks you how old you are. You are thirty years old.
a1-17.prompt: Tell Károly you are thirty years old, then ask how old he is.
a1-17.target: Harminc éves vagyok. És te, hány éves vagy?
a1-17.english: I am thirty years old. And you, how old are you?
a1-17.canDo: I can ask someone how old they are using Hány éves vagy?

a1-18.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Do You Live?
a1-18.scenario: Anna asks where you live and what your address is.
a1-18.prompt: Tell Anna you live in Budapest, and give your address as Kossuth Street 10.
a1-18.target: Budapesten lakom. A címem Kossuth utca 10.
a1-18.english: I live in Budapest. My address is Kossuth Street 10.
a1-18.canDo: I can ask someone where they live and say where I live.

a1-19.title: Communicative Challenge: Phone Number
a1-19.scenario: Károly asks for your phone number so he can call you later.
cues: Say it is your phone number
a1-19.target: A telefonszámom nulla hat, harminc, egy kettő három, négy öt hat hét.
a1-19.canDo: I can ask for and give a Hungarian phone number.

a1-20.title: Communicative Challenge: Exchanging Details
a1-20.scenario: You meet Anna at the community center and she asks about you.
a1-20.prompt: Tell Anna you are thirty years old and that you live in Budapest.
a1-20.english: I am thirty years old. I live in Budapest.
a1-20.canDo: I can exchange basic personal details including age, address, and phone number.

a1-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Meeting New Friends
a1-20-consolidation.scenario: At a meetup, Károly asks your name, where you live, and how old you are.
a1-20-consolidation.prompt: Say you are Meg, you live here, and you are thirty years old.
a1-20-consolidation.target: Én Meg vagyok. Itt lakom. Harminc éves vagyok.
a1-20-consolidation.english: I am Meg. I live here. I am thirty years old.
a1-20-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and answer about age.

a1-21.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is This?
a1-21.scenario: You ask Károly what is on the table, then say what you think it is.
a1-21.prompt: Ask what it is, then say it is a coffee.
a1-21.english: What is this? This is a coffee.
a1-21.canDo: I can point at something and ask what it is with Mi ez?

a1-22.title: Communicative Challenge: Tables and Chairs
a1-22.scenario: Károly is showing you around his place. You point out the furniture you see.
a1-22.prompt: Say that this is a table, and that is a chair.
a1-22.target: Ez egy asztal. Az egy szék.
a1-22.english: This is a table. That is a chair.
a1-22.canDo: I can name everyday objects and say there's one of something with egy.

a1-23.title: Communicative Challenge: In the Kitchen
a1-23.scenario: Meg is looking for the phone in the apartment and asks you where it is.
a1-23.prompt: Tell Meg that the phone is in the kitchen.
cues: Name the phone with the article
Say it is in the kitchen
a1-23.english: The phone is in the kitchen.
a1-23.canDo: I can say what's in a room using the suffix -ban/-ben.

a1-24.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is Here
a1-24.scenario: You and Károly are checking what is in the room. He asks about a chair and a lamp.
a1-24.prompt: Say that there is a chair here, but there is no lamp here.
cues: Say there is a chair here
Say there is no lamp here
a1-24.target: Itt van egy szék. Itt nincs lámpa.
a1-24.english: There is a chair here. There is no lamp here.
a1-24.canDo: I can say whether something exists or not with van and nincs.

a1-25.title: Communicative Challenge: Finding the Key
a1-25.scenario: Meg is in the flat and asks about the key. You see it in the room.
a1-25.prompt: Tell Meg that this is a key, and it is in the room.
cues: Say it is in the room
a1-25.target: Ez egy kulcs. A szobában van.
a1-25.english: This is a key. It is in the room.
a1-25.canDo: I can talk about objects in the apartment and where they are.

a1-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Around the Flat
a1-25-consolidation.scenario: You visit Károly's apartment and notice something on the table. You ask what it is, and where the key is.
a1-25-consolidation.prompt: Ask what that is, and ask where the key is.
a1-25-consolidation.target: Mi az? Hol van a kulcs?
a1-25-consolidation.english: What is that? Where is the key?
a1-25-consolidation.canDo: I can name objects and say where they are using itt, ott, and -ban/-ben.

a1-26.title: Communicative Challenge: My Family
a1-26.scenario: Meg is looking at a photo on Károly's desk and asks who is in it.
a1-26.prompt: Tell Meg that this is your family, and point out your mother.
a1-26.target: Ez a családom. Ő az anyám.
a1-26.english: This is my family. She is my mother.
a1-26.canDo: I can name close family members: anya, apa, szülő.

a1-27.title: Communicative Challenge: Siblings and Children
a1-27.scenario: Károly asks if you have a sibling or a son.
a1-27.prompt: Tell Károly that you have a sibling, but you don't have a son.
cues: Say you do not have a son
a1-27.english: I have a sibling. I don't have a son.
a1-27.canDo: I can name more family members: testvér, fiú, lány, gyerek.

a1-28.title: Communicative Challenge: Older and Younger
a1-28.scenario: Meg sees a young man in the hallway and asks if he is your younger brother.
a1-28.prompt: Tell Meg that he is not your younger brother, he is your older brother.
cues: Say he is not your younger brother
Say he is your older brother
a1-28.target: Ő nem az öcsém. Ő a bátyám.
a1-28.english: He is not my younger brother. He is my older brother.
a1-28.canDo: I can distinguish older and younger siblings: báty, öcs, nővér, húg.

a1-29.title: Communicative Challenge: Grandparents
a1-29.scenario: You and Meg are looking at family pictures. You point out your grandparents.
a1-29.prompt: Point to the photo and introduce your grandmother and your grandfather.
a1-29.target: Ő a nagymamám. Ő a nagypapám.
a1-29.english: She is my grandmother. He is my grandfather.
a1-29.canDo: I can introduce my grandparents: nagymama, nagypapa.

a1-30.title: Communicative Challenge: Family Gathering
a1-30.scenario: Károly shows you a big family portrait with everyone gathered together.
a1-30.prompt: Comment that there are many family members in the photo, and they are together.
cues: Say there are many family members in the photo
Say the family members are together
a1-30.target: Sok családtag van a képen. A családtagok együtt vannak.
a1-30.english: There are many family members in the photo. The family members are together.
a1-30.canDo: I can say there are many family members in the photo and that they are together.

a1-30-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Family Overview
a1-30-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks you about your family back home and if you have an older sister.
a1-30-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that this is your family, and you have an older sister.
cues: Say that you have an older sister
a1-30-consolidation.target: Ez a családom. Van egy nővérem.
a1-30-consolidation.english: This is my family. I have an older sister.
a1-30-consolidation.canDo: I can introduce my family and say who my siblings are.

a1-31.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is He Like?
a1-31.scenario: Meg sees a new colleague across the room and asks Károly what he is like.
a1-31.prompt: Ask what he is like, then say that he is tall.
a1-31.english: What is he like? He is tall.
a1-31.canDo: I can ask what someone is like with Milyen?

a1-32.title: Communicative Challenge: Hair and Appearance
a1-32.scenario: Károly describes a friend in a photo to Meg. Meg asks about her hair.
a1-32.prompt: Tell Meg that she is young and has brown hair.
cues: Say that she has brown hair
a1-32.english: She is young. She has brown hair.
a1-32.canDo: I can describe someone's hair using van with a possessive.

a1-33.title: Communicative Challenge: Character
a1-33.scenario: You and Meg meet Károly's brother. Meg asks about his personality.
a1-33.prompt: Tell Meg that he is kind and funny, and that he is not loud.
cues: Say he is kind and funny
a1-33.target: Ő kedves és vicces. Nem hangos.
a1-33.english: He is kind and funny. He is not loud.
a1-33.canDo: I can describe someone's character: kedves, vicces, csendes, hangos.

a1-34.title: Communicative Challenge: Tall Friend
a1-34.scenario: Károly introduces a tall friend standing near the door to Meg.
a1-34.prompt: Tell Meg that he is a tall man, and he is your friend.
cues: Say he is a tall man
a1-34.target: Ő egy magas férfi. Ő a barátom.
a1-34.english: He is a tall man. He is my friend.
a1-34.canDo: I can talk about people in general: ember, férfi, nő, barát.

a1-35.title: Communicative Challenge: Acquaintances
a1-35.scenario: Meg asks about a quiet acquaintance who is helping Károly move a table.
a1-35.prompt: Tell Meg that he is an acquaintance, and he is very strong.
a1-35.english: He is an acquaintance. He is very strong.
a1-35.canDo: I can describe people, combining this unit's adjectives and linking words.

a1-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Describing a Friend
a1-35-consolidation.scenario: Meg asks what your friend is like in general.
a1-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that he is tall and kind, and very funny.
cues: Say he is tall and kind
a1-35-consolidation.target: Ő magas és kedves. Nagyon vicces.
a1-35-consolidation.english: He is tall and kind. He is very funny.
a1-35-consolidation.canDo: I can describe people's appearance and character using adjectives and linking words.

a1-36.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are the Books?
a1-36.scenario: Károly is looking for the books and asks Meg where they are.
a1-36.prompt: Tell Károly that the books are here.
a1-36.canDo: I can make a Hungarian noun plural with -k.

a1-37.title: Communicative Challenge: Big and Small
a1-37.scenario: Meg shows Károly the room and tells him what the windows and the doors are like.
a1-37.prompt: Say that the windows are big and the doors are small.
a1-37.target: Az ablakok nagyok. Az ajtók kicsik.
a1-37.english: The windows are big. The doors are small.
a1-37.canDo: I can say what plural things are like, as in A székek nagyok.

a1-38.title: Communicative Challenge: Everyone Is Here
a1-38.scenario: At the gathering Károly looks around for the children and the families. Meg has just seen them.
a1-38.prompt: Tell Károly that the children and the families are together.
cues: Mention the children and the families
a1-38.target: A gyerekek és a családok együtt vannak.
a1-38.english: The children and the families are together.
a1-38.canDo: I can use plural people words such as gyerekek, emberek and családok.

a1-39.title: Communicative Challenge: New and Old
a1-39.scenario: Károly asks Meg about the books and the chairs in the room.
a1-39.prompt: Tell Károly that the books are new, but the chairs are old.
cues: Say what the books are like
a1-39.target: A könyvek újak, de a székek régiek.
a1-39.english: The books are new, but the chairs are old.
a1-39.canDo: I can say things are new or old, before or after the noun.

a1-40.title: Communicative Challenge: More Chairs
a1-40.scenario: The room is filling up and Meg tells Károly about the chairs.
a1-40.prompt: Tell Károly that a few chairs are here and that more are needed.
cues: Say how many chairs there are
a1-40.target: Néhány szék van itt. Több szék kell.
a1-40.english: A few chairs are here. More chairs are needed.
a1-40.canDo: I can say a few, more or what is needed with néhány, több and kell.

a1-40-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Gathering
a1-40-consolidation.scenario: Meg looks around the room and reports to Károly.
a1-40-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the friends are all here and that there are many chairs.
cues: Say the friends are all here
a1-40-consolidation.target: A barátok mind itt vannak. Sok szék van itt.
a1-40-consolidation.english: The friends are all here. There are many chairs here.
a1-40-consolidation.canDo: I can say how many with sok, néhány and több, and that all are there with mind.

a1-41.title: Communicative Challenge: Her Things
a1-41.scenario: Anna has gone out. Meg asks you where Anna's key and phone are.
a1-41.prompt: Tell Meg that Anna's key is here and her phone is there.
a1-41.target: A kulcsa itt van. A telefonja ott van.
a1-41.english: Her key is here. Her phone is there.
a1-41.canDo: I can say that something is his or hers: kulcsa, táskája, telefonja.

a1-42.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Place
a1-42.scenario: You and Károly are showing Meg around the flat you share. Your room is small, and your friend has just arrived.
a1-42.prompt: Tell Meg that our room is small and that our friend is here.
a1-42.target: A szobánk kicsi. A barátunk itt van.
a1-42.english: Our room is small. Our friend is here.
a1-42.canDo: I can say our, your (plural) and their things: szobánk, barátotok, családjuk.

a1-43.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Is It?
a1-43.scenario: Meg holds up a key and a bag. You know the bag belongs to you.
a1-43.prompt: Ask whose the key is, then say the bag is mine.
a1-43.target: Kié a kulcs? A táska az enyém.
a1-43.english: Whose is the key? The bag is mine.
a1-43.canDo: I can say that something is mine, yours or his/hers: az enyém, a tiéd, az övé.

a1-44.title: Communicative Challenge: Ours
a1-44.scenario: Károly asks about the flat and the car you share with Meg.
a1-44.prompt: Tell Károly that the flat belongs to you and Meg, and that you have a car.
cues: Say the flat belongs to you both
a1-44.target: A lakás a miénk. Van egy autónk.
a1-44.english: The flat is ours. We have a car.
a1-44.canDo: I can say that something is ours, yours (plural) or theirs: a miénk, a tiétek, az övék.

a1-45.title: Communicative Challenge: My Own Room
a1-45.scenario: Károly asks about your new flat, your room and your keys.
a1-45.prompt: Tell him you have your own room and your own key.
cues: Say you have your own room
Say you have your own key
a1-45.target: Van saját szobám. Van saját kulcsom.
a1-45.english: I have my own room. I have my own key.
a1-45.canDo: I can say something is my own with saját: Van saját szobám.

a1-45-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Things
a1-45-consolidation.scenario: Meg and Károly are leaving the flat and checking whose key and bag are whose.
a1-45-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly the key is mine and the bag is hers.
a1-45-consolidation.target: A kulcs az enyém. A táska az övé.
a1-45-consolidation.english: The key is mine. The bag is his/hers.
a1-45-consolidation.canDo: I can say whose things are whose: mine, yours, his, ours and theirs.

a1-51.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Is the Bag?
a1-51.scenario: You are in Meg and Károly’s flat. Meg is leaving and cannot find her bag, but you can see it.
a1-51.prompt: Tell Meg that the bag is in the bedroom.
cues: Say which room it is in
a1-51.english: The bag is in the bedroom.
a1-51.canDo: I can say which room someone or something is in.

a1-52.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Where?
a1-52.scenario: Károly phones to ask where everyone is. You are at home with Anna.
a1-52.prompt: Tell Károly that you are in the living room and that Anna is in the garden.
a1-52.target: A nappaliban vagyok. Anna a kertben van.
a1-52.english: I am in the living room. Anna is in the garden.
a1-52.canDo: I can say where I am, where you are and where someone else is.

a1-53.title: Communicative Challenge: Around Town
a1-53.scenario: You and Károly are listing where your family is today.
a1-53.prompt: Say that Mum is in the shop and that the child is at school.
a1-53.target: Anya a boltban van. A gyerek az iskolában van.
a1-53.english: Mum is in the shop. The child is at school.
a1-53.canDo: I can say that someone is in the shop, the park, the library or the class.

a1-54.title: Communicative Challenge: Showing the Flat
a1-54.scenario: You are showing Anna round the flat before she moves in.
a1-54.prompt: Tell Anna that there is a table in the living room and that there is no chair in the kitchen.
cues: Say what is in the living room
Say what the kitchen does not have
a1-54.target: A nappaliban van egy asztal. A konyhában nincs szék.
a1-54.english: There is a table in the living room. There is no chair in the kitchen.
a1-54.canDo: I can say what there is, or is not, in a place.

a1-55.title: Communicative Challenge: Not the Kitchen
a1-55.scenario: You are walking through the flat with Anna. Károly is not where she expects him.
a1-55.prompt: Tell Anna that Károly is not in the kitchen, and that this room is not the kitchen but the bathroom.
cues: Say Károly is not in the kitchen
Say this room is the bathroom
a1-55.target: Károly nincs a konyhában. Ez nem a konyha, ez a fürdőszoba.
a1-55.english: Károly is not in the kitchen. This is not the kitchen, this is the bathroom.
a1-55.canDo: I can say who or what is not in a place, and what a room is not.

a1-55-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Where Things Are
a1-55-consolidation.scenario: Anna is about to leave the flat. You tell her about her bag and ask about the key.
a1-55-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna that the bag is in the big living room, and ask where the key is.
a1-55-consolidation.target: A táska a nagy nappaliban van. Hol van a kulcs?
a1-55-consolidation.english: The bag is in the big living room. Where is the key?
a1-55-consolidation.canDo: I can say where people and things are in a flat and around town.

a1-46.title: Communicative Challenge: Who I Am
a1-46.scenario: At a gathering, Anna asks you who you are and where you live.
a1-46.prompt: Tell Anna who you are and where you live (you are Meg).
a1-46.english: I am Meg. I live in Budapest.
a1-46.canDo: I can say who I am and where I live: Én Meg vagyok. Budapesten lakom.

a1-47.title: Communicative Challenge: My Family
a1-47.scenario: Meg is looking at a photo of your family.
a1-47.prompt: Tell Meg you have a sibling and that your mother is very kind.
cues: Say what your mother is like
a1-47.target: Van egy testvérem. Az anyám nagyon kedves.
a1-47.english: I have a sibling. My mother is very kind.
a1-47.canDo: I can name my family and say what I have: Ő az anyám. Van egy testvérem.

a1-48.title: Communicative Challenge: The Room
a1-48.scenario: You are in the flat with Károly, who wants to know what is in the room.
a1-48.prompt: Tell Károly how many chairs there are and where the key is.
cues: Say how many chairs there are
a1-48.target: Három szék van itt. A kulcs a konyhában van.
a1-48.english: There are three chairs here. The key is in the kitchen.
a1-48.canDo: I can name things and say where they are: A kulcs a konyhában van.

a1-49.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Things
a1-49.scenario: You and Károly are leaving the flat and checking whose things are whose.
a1-49.prompt: Tell Károly that the bag is yours (it belongs to you) and that you have your own car.
cues: Say the bag belongs to you
Say you have your own car
a1-49.target: A táska az enyém. Van saját autóm.
a1-49.english: The bag is mine. I have my own car.
a1-49.canDo: I can say whose things are whose: A táska az enyém. A kulcsa itt van.

a1-50.title: Communicative Challenge: Excuse Me
a1-50.scenario: You are at the gathering and want to find the kitchen.
a1-50.prompt: Politely ask where the kitchen is, and thank them.
a1-50.target: Elnézést, hol van a konyha? Köszönöm!
a1-50.english: Excuse me, where is the kitchen? Thank you!
a1-50.canDo: I can ask politely and thank someone: Elnézést, hol van a konyha? Köszönöm!

a1-50-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Bag
a1-50-consolidation.scenario: At the gathering, a bag and a phone are lying on the table. The phone belongs to you.
a1-50-consolidation.prompt: Ask whose the bag is and say that the phone belongs to you.
cues: Say the phone belongs to you
a1-50-consolidation.target: Kié a táska? A telefon az enyém.
a1-50-consolidation.english: Whose is the bag? The phone is mine.
a1-50-consolidation.canDo: I can ask and say whose things are whose: Kié a táska? A telefon az enyém.

a1-56.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are You Going
a1-56.scenario: You meet Károly at the door of the flat. He has his bag, and you want to go to the park.
a1-56.prompt: Ask Károly where he is going, and say that you are going to the park.
a1-56.english: Where are you going? I am going to the park.
a1-56.canDo: I can say where someone is going, such as to the shop or the park.

a1-57.title: Communicative Challenge: Here and There
a1-57.scenario: Meg phones you from town. You are in the café, and soon you are going to the cinema.
a1-57.prompt: Tell Meg that you are in the café, and that you are going to the cinema.
a1-57.target: A kávézóban vagyok. A moziba megyek.
a1-57.english: I am in the café. I am going to the cinema.
a1-57.canDo: I can answer Hol? with -ban/-ben and Hová? with -ba/-be.

a1-58.title: Communicative Challenge: Big Park, New Restaurant
a1-58.scenario: Anna asks where everyone is going. You are going to the big park, and Meg is going to the new restaurant.
a1-58.prompt: Tell Anna that you are going to the big park and that Meg is going to the new restaurant.
a1-58.target: A nagy parkba megyek. Meg az új étterembe megy.
a1-58.english: I am going to the big park. Meg is going to the new restaurant.
a1-58.canDo: I can say where someone is going with an adjective, such as the big park.

a1-59.title: Communicative Challenge: Not the Shop
a1-59.scenario: Anna thinks you are going to the shop. You are not: you are going to the library.
a1-59.prompt: Tell Anna that you are not going to the shop, and that you are going to the library.
cues: Say where you are not going
a1-59.target: Nem a boltba megyek, a könyvtárba megyek.
a1-59.english: I am not going to the shop, I am going to the library.
a1-59.canDo: I can say that I or someone else is not going somewhere.

a1-60.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Goes to the Office
a1-60.scenario: Károly has his bag in his hand. You think he is going to the shop, and you want to know who is going to the office.
a1-60.prompt: Ask Károly if he is going to the shop, and ask who is going to the office.
cues: Ask if he is going to the shop
Ask who is going to the office
a1-60.target: A boltba mész? Ki megy az irodába?
a1-60.english: Are you going to the shop? Who is going to the office?
a1-60.canDo: I can ask a yes/no question about where someone is going.

a1-60-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Going Places
a1-60-consolidation.scenario: Meg phones you before you leave the flat. You want to know where she is, and you are going to the new café.
a1-60-consolidation.prompt: Ask Meg where she is, and say that you are going to the new café.
a1-60-consolidation.target: Hol vagy? Az új kávézóba megyek.
a1-60-consolidation.english: Where are you? I am going to the new café.
a1-60-consolidation.canDo: I can say where people are going and where they are, with -ba/-be and -ban/-ben.

a1-61.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Do
a1-61.scenario: Anna phones you from the library. She wants to know what you do in the living room: do you read, or do you study?
a1-61.prompt: Tell Anna that you read in the living room and that you study.
cues: Say you read in the living room
a1-61.english: I read in the living room. I study.
a1-61.canDo: I can say what I do, like olvasok, tanulok and főzök.

a1-62.title: Communicative Challenge: Are You Waiting?
a1-62.scenario: You see Meg in the garden. She has a book and she seems to be waiting for someone.
a1-62.prompt: Ask Meg if she reads and if she waits here.
a1-62.english: Are you reading? Are you waiting here?
a1-62.canDo: I can ask a friend what they do, like Tanulsz? and Olvasol?

a1-63.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Does What
a1-63.scenario: Anna asks what Meg and Károly are doing in the flat. Károly is in the kitchen and Meg is in the living room with a book.
a1-63.prompt: Tell Anna that Károly cooks in the kitchen and that Meg reads.
cues: Say Károly cooks in the kitchen
a1-63.target: Károly a konyhában főz. Meg olvas.
a1-63.english: Károly cooks in the kitchen. Meg reads.
a1-63.canDo: I can say what someone else does, like Anna olvas and Károly főz.

a1-64.title: Communicative Challenge: Not at Home
a1-64.scenario: Károly asks where you read and where you cook. You like the garden, and you do not cook at home.
a1-64.prompt: Tell Károly that you read in the garden and that you do not cook at home.
cues: Say you read in the garden
Say you do not cook at home
a1-64.target: A kertben olvasok. Otthon nem főzök.
a1-64.english: I read in the garden. I do not cook at home.
a1-64.canDo: I can say and ask where I do something, like A kertben olvasok and Hol tanulsz?

a1-65.title: Communicative Challenge: My Day
a1-65.scenario: Anna asks you about your day: what do you do in the morning and in the afternoon?
a1-65.prompt: Tell Anna that you study in the morning and walk in the park in the afternoon.
cues: Say you study in the morning
Say you walk in the park in the afternoon
a1-65.target: Reggel tanulok. Délután a parkban sétálok.
a1-65.english: In the morning I study. In the afternoon I walk in the park.
a1-65.canDo: I can say when I do something, like Reggel olvasok.

a1-65-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: My Day
a1-65-consolidation.scenario: It is Saturday evening. You read in the morning, and you want to know if Meg cooks in the evening.
a1-65-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that you read in the morning and ask her if she cooks in the evening.
cues: Say you read in the morning
Ask if she cooks in the evening
a1-65-consolidation.english: In the morning I read. Do you cook in the evening?
a1-65-consolidation.canDo: I can say what I, you and other people do, and where and when.

a1-66.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Does It
a1-66.scenario: You are at home with Meg and Károly. Someone is cooking in the kitchen, and you want to know who it is. You are reading.
a1-66.prompt: Ask Meg who is cooking and say that you are reading.
a1-66.english: Who is cooking? I am reading.
a1-66.canDo: I can ask who does something, like Ki olvas? and Ki főz?

a1-67.title: Communicative Challenge: When and Where
a1-67.scenario: Anna studies, but you do not know when or where. You want to ask her.
a1-67.prompt: Ask Anna when she studies and where she studies.
a1-67.english: When do you study? Where do you study?
a1-67.canDo: I can ask when someone does something, like Mikor tanulsz?

a1-68.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Not
a1-68.scenario: It is evening at home. Meg is not cooking, and you are not cooking either: you are reading.
a1-68.prompt: Ask Meg why she does not cook and say that you do not cook because you read.
cues: Ask why she does not cook
Say you do not cook because you read
a1-68.target: Miért nem főzöl? Nem főzök, mert olvasok.
a1-68.english: Why do you not cook? I do not cook, because I read.
a1-68.canDo: I can ask why, like Miért nem főzöl?

a1-69.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Here
a1-69.scenario: Mariann phones and asks for Anna. Anna is not at home. She is walking in the park.
a1-69.prompt: Tell Mariann that Anna is not here and that she is walking in the park.
cues: Say that Anna is not here
a1-69.target: Anna nincs itt. A parkban sétál.
a1-69.english: Anna is not here. She is walking in the park.
a1-69.canDo: I can say that someone is not there, like Anna nincs itt.

a1-70.title: Communicative Challenge: And You
a1-70.scenario: Mariann phones from the park. You are at home and you are reading.
a1-70.prompt: Tell Mariann that you read and ask her back.
a1-70.canDo: I can ask the same question back, like És te?

a1-70-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Questions
a1-70-consolidation.scenario: Someone is cooking in the kitchen, and Meg is not. You want to know who cooks and why Meg does not.
a1-70-consolidation.prompt: Ask Meg who cooks and ask her why she does not cook.
cues: Ask why she does not cook
a1-70-consolidation.english: Who cooks? Why do you not cook?
a1-70-consolidation.canDo: I can ask who, when, where and why someone does something.

a1-71.title: Communicative Challenge: What We Do
a1-71.scenario: Anna phones you (Meg) from the library. She wants to know what you and Károly do in the kitchen and in the living room.
a1-71.prompt: Tell Anna that you and Károly cook in the kitchen and read in the living room.
cues: Say you cook in the kitchen
Say you read in the living room
a1-71.target: A konyhában főzünk. A nappaliban olvasunk.
a1-71.english: We cook in the kitchen. We read in the living room.
a1-71.canDo: I can say what we do, like olvasunk, tanulunk and főzünk.

a1-72.title: Communicative Challenge: Are You Studying?
a1-72.scenario: You phone Meg and Mariann, who are both at the library. You want to know if they study now and if they walk in the park in the afternoon.
a1-72.prompt: Ask Meg and Mariann if they study now and if they walk in the park in the afternoon.
cues: Ask if they walk in the park in the afternoon
a1-72.target: Most tanultok? Délután a parkban sétáltok?
a1-72.english: Are you studying now? Do you walk in the park in the afternoon?
a1-72.canDo: I can ask two or more friends what they do, like Tanultok? and Olvastok?

a1-73.title: Communicative Challenge: What They Do
a1-73.scenario: Meg phones you. András and Károly are in the kitchen, and Anna and Mariann are in the library. Meg asks what they all do.
a1-73.prompt: Tell Meg that András and Károly cook in the kitchen and that Anna and Mariann study in the library.
cues: Say András and Károly cook in the kitchen
Say Anna and Mariann study in the library
a1-73.target: András és Károly a konyhában főznek. Anna és Mariann a könyvtárban tanulnak.
a1-73.english: András and Károly cook in the kitchen. Anna and Mariann study in the library.
a1-73.canDo: I can say what other people do, like Főznek and Anna és Károly olvasnak.

a1-74.title: Communicative Challenge: Yes, We Do
a1-74.scenario: Anna asks you and Károly two questions: Do you read? Do you cook?
a1-74.prompt: Answer for you and Károly: yes, you read, and no, you do not cook.
cues: Say no, you do not cook
a1-74.english: Yes, we read. No, we do not cook.
a1-74.canDo: I can use all six persons of a verb, like pihenek, pihenünk and pihennek.

a1-75.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Day
a1-75.scenario: Mariann asks you and Meg about your Saturday: what do you do in the morning, in the afternoon and in the evening?
a1-75.prompt: Tell Mariann that you and Meg read in the morning, walk in the park in the afternoon and cook in the evening.
cues: Say you read in the morning
Say you walk in the park in the afternoon
Say you cook in the evening
a1-75.target: Reggel olvasunk, délután a parkban sétálunk, este főzünk.
a1-75.english: In the morning we read, in the afternoon we walk in the park, in the evening we cook.
a1-75.canDo: I can tell a day in order for us, like Reggel ébredünk and Este pihenünk.

a1-75-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Our Saturday
a1-75-consolidation.scenario: It is Saturday evening and Anna phones. You and Károly read in the morning and rest in the evening. You want to know if she and Mariann cook.
a1-75-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna that you and Károly read in the morning and rest in the evening, then ask if she and Mariann cook.
cues: Say you read in the morning and rest in the evening
Ask if she and Mariann cook
a1-75-consolidation.target: Reggel olvasunk, este pihenünk. Ti főztök?
a1-75-consolidation.english: In the morning we read, in the evening we rest. Do you all cook?
a1-75-consolidation.canDo: I can say what we, you all and they do, and when.

a1-76.title: Communicative Challenge: What Time Is It?
a1-76.scenario: You and Anna meet Meg in the park. Meg asks what time it is. Meg asks what time it is. Your phone says five o'clock. Then you ask Anna the time, to check.
a1-76.prompt: Tell Meg that it is five o'clock, then ask Anna what time it is.
cues: Say that it is five o'clock
Ask Anna what time it is
a1-76.target: Öt óra van. Anna, hány óra van?
a1-76.english: It is five o'clock. Anna, what time is it?
a1-76.canDo: I can ask what time it is and tell whole hours, like Hány óra van? Öt óra van.

a1-77.title: Communicative Challenge: Morning, Not Evening
a1-77.scenario: Károly phones you from the library. You are at home and the clock shows half past six in the morning, but he thinks it is evening.
a1-77.prompt: Tell Károly that it is not evening but morning, and give the time.
cues: Say it is not evening but morning
Say the time: half past six
a1-77.target: Nem este, hanem reggel van. Reggel fél hét van.
a1-77.english: It is not evening, it is morning. It is 6:30 in the morning.
a1-77.canDo: I can say the time with the part of the day, like Reggel hét óra van.

a1-78.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Study Days
a1-78.scenario: Mariann asks you and Meg on which days you study in the library.
a1-78.prompt: Tell Mariann that you and Meg study on Tuesday and Thursday.
cues: Say you study on Tuesday and on Thursday
a1-78.english: On Tuesday and Thursday we study.
a1-78.canDo: I can say on which day something happens, like Kedden tanulunk.

a1-79.title: Communicative Challenge: Months in the Park
a1-79.scenario: Anna asks in which months you and Károly walk in the park.
a1-79.prompt: Tell Anna that you and Károly walk in the park in June and in September.
cues: Say you walk in the park
Name the two months: June and September
a1-79.target: Júniusban és szeptemberben a parkban sétálunk.
a1-79.english: In June and in September we walk in the park.
a1-79.canDo: I can say in which month something happens, like Júniusban a parkban sétálunk.

a1-80.title: Communicative Challenge: My Week
a1-80.scenario: Meg asks about your week. On Monday morning you study, and on Saturday afternoon you walk in the park.
a1-80.prompt: Tell Meg that on Monday morning you study and on Saturday afternoon you walk in the park.
cues: Say what you do on Monday morning
Say what you do on Saturday afternoon, and where
a1-80.target: Hétfőn reggel tanulok, szombaton délután a parkban sétálok.
a1-80.english: On Monday morning I study, on Saturday afternoon I walk in the park.
a1-80.canDo: I can say what I do on which day and part of the day, like Hétfőn reggel tanulok.

a1-80-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Day and Time
a1-80-consolidation.scenario: Károly phones in the evening. You look at the calendar and the clock: it is Wednesday, half past nine in the evening.
a1-80-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that today is Wednesday and that it is half past nine in the evening.
cues: Say what day it is today
Say the time, with the part of the day
a1-80-consolidation.target: Ma szerda van. Este fél tíz van.
a1-80-consolidation.english: Today is Wednesday. It is 9:30 in the evening.
a1-80-consolidation.canDo: I can say the time and the day, like Fél tíz van and Ma szerda van.

a1-81.title: Communicative Challenge: How Often
a1-81.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) about your habits: does Meg read in the morning, and does she rest in the afternoon?
a1-81.prompt: Tell Károly that you always read in the morning and sometimes rest in the afternoon.
cues: Say you always read in the morning
Say you sometimes rest in the afternoon
a1-81.target: Reggel mindig olvasok. Délután néha pihenek.
a1-81.english: In the morning I always read. In the afternoon I sometimes rest.
a1-81.canDo: I can say how often I do something, like Mindig olvasok and Néha pihenek.

a1-82.title: Communicative Challenge: Every Saturday
a1-82.scenario: Anna wants to plan a Saturday with you (Meg). She asks how often you do sport and whether you cook in the evening.
a1-82.prompt: Tell Anna that you do sport every Saturday and that you never cook in the evening.
cues: Say you do sport every Saturday
Say you never cook in the evening
a1-82.target: Minden szombaton sportolok. Este soha nem főzök.
a1-82.english: I do sport every Saturday. In the evening I never cook.
a1-82.canDo: I can ask and say how often, like Milyen gyakran sportolsz? and Minden szombaton sportolok.

a1-83.title: Communicative Challenge: Too and After
a1-83.scenario: You (Meg) study in the library. Károly asks about Anna and about what you do after lunch.
a1-83.prompt: Tell Károly that Anna studies too and that you rest after lunch.
cues: Say that you rest after lunch
a1-83.target: Anna is tanul. Ebéd után pihenek.
a1-83.english: Anna studies too. After lunch I rest.
a1-83.canDo: I can say someone does something too, like Én is olvasok and Anna is tanul.

a1-84.title: Communicative Challenge: My Week
a1-84.scenario: Anna phones you (Meg) and asks when you read and whether you do sport on Mondays.
a1-84.prompt: Tell Anna that you always read in the morning and that on Mondays you usually do not do sport.
cues: Say that on Mondays you usually do not do sport
a1-84.target: Reggel mindig olvasok. Hétfőn általában nem sportolok.
a1-84.english: In the morning I always read. On Mondays I usually do not do sport.
a1-84.canDo: I can put a time word and a frequency word before the verb, like Reggel mindig olvasok.

a1-85.title: Communicative Challenge: Where I Work
a1-85.scenario: Anna phones you (Meg). She wants to know where you work and whether you have breakfast every morning.
a1-85.prompt: Tell Anna that you work in the library and that you always have breakfast in the morning.
cues: Say that you always have breakfast in the morning
a1-85.target: A könyvtárban dolgozom. Reggel mindig reggelizem.
a1-85.english: I work in the library. In the morning I always have breakfast.
a1-85.canDo: I can say what someone does with -ik verbs, like Anna dolgozik and Meg reggelizik.

a1-85-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: My Habits
a1-85-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you (Meg) whether you work on Mondays and on Saturdays, and what you do on Saturdays.
a1-85-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that you work on Mondays, that you never work on Saturdays and that you usually do sport on Saturdays.
cues: Say you never work on Saturdays
Say you usually do sport on Saturdays
a1-85-consolidation.target: Hétfőn dolgozom. Szombaton soha nem dolgozom, de szoktam sportolni.
a1-85-consolidation.english: On Mondays I work. On Saturdays I never work, but I usually do sport.
a1-85-consolidation.canDo: I can tell how often I do things, with mindig, soha nem and szoktam.
